readerCopy.body: An unexpected change can force a decision before the old timeline has had a chance to adjust. When Uranus conjoins the North Node, disruption and forward movement meet, allowing a cancellation, sudden offer, technical change, move, departure, or break in the old setup to alter what is available quickly. The surprise can expose an overdue change without making every impulsive response useful. The next direction becomes easier to judge after the immediate facts are handled and the first rush of adrenaline has passed.
